title: native: a card whose last turn is a question ends as ASKED, not as a plain no-result (#2548)
body:
The issue's title named a mechanism that is not real, and this does not fix it.
The runtime dogfood of 2026-09-22 ran the shape on both benches -- a card whose
STEP 2 forbids writing RESULT.md until an operator approves and tells the model
to ask and wait -- and measured 5.22 s on hulk and 5.49 s on the Studio:
`opencode run` is non-interactive, it finishes the turn and exits 0, and the slot
is freed at once. There is no slot to free and nothing to interrupt.

What is real is the verdict. Both runs ended `NATIVE INCOMPLETE ... why=no-result`
-- the token reserved for a MODEL THAT CHOSE TO PUBLISH NOTHING -- with nothing
anywhere recording that the card ended by asking. A card that asked and a card
that crashed into silence are then one row to every reader: the requeue cannot
retry the asker on another route, and the ledger cannot count which models ask.

So the run writes the report the card never wrote, at the job root:

    RESULT: ASKED <the question, one line, bounded and escaped>
    asked: <label> ended its last turn with a question, published no report ...
    written-by: nova-swarm native (the card published no report of its own)

Four conditions, all necessary, each one a different card this must not claim:
the last line the CHILD wrote in harness-output.log is a question (ends `?` once
its decoration is trimmed, or opens `would you like|should i|do you want|shall
i|can you confirm`; the wall's own SANDBOX lines are skipped there exactly as
harness=silent skips them); the child exited 0, because a non-zero exit is
already rc=<n>; no RESULT.md anywhere gather looks, because a card that published
owns its report; and ./repo holds no commit past its base, because a model that
asked rhetorically and went on and committed the work answered itself. The
machinery's own ends come first: idle, terminated, wall and fence are that end
whatever the last line was.

The verdict line does not move. A report the machinery wrote is not the card's
own, so nativeLeftAResult does not count it and a card that did nothing but ask
still reads INCOMPLETE why=no-result -- counting it would hand `OK` to a run that
produced nothing, the fault that made the word earn itself (#1844). The report
carries no findings head, so it classes plan-only and can never be counted as
work done, and it never overwrites a report a card published.

Not built here, deliberately: Glenn's bounded steer channel (post the question to
the bus, wait for one typed answer, feed it back as a turn) is a later card, and
the never-ask sentence in the card preamble is #2588/METHODS.

Tests: a table over the four endings driven by the dogfood's own transcript tails
(hulk's two lines and the Studio's one, byte for byte) -- the question, a normal
DONE run, a crash, and a question followed by a commit -- plus the report's shape,
the refusal to overwrite, AskedEnd against a job on disk with a real ./repo, and
three cmd-level runs through the fake harness. Red without the change: a card that
ended by asking left no report at all.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
